newsitem.title: USA: Service Corp offers to buy $536 mln in notes.
newsitem.headline: Service Corp offers to buy $536 mln in notes.

text.p: Service Corp International said it is offering to buy a total of $536 million of three issues of its oustanding notes.
It said the notes covered include $150 million of 7-7/8 percent notes due February 1, 2013; $200 million of 8-3/8 percent notes due December 15, 2004; and $186 million of medium-term notes, Series A.

Service Corp said the transactions would reduce its annual interest costs in future periods and the costs of such transactions would be included in its financial results for the quarter ended March 31.
The company said NationsBanc Capital Markets Inc is serving as dealer manager.
